history.text: Sabin won a four-way match to unify the X Division title with the WWA International Cruiserweight Championship.
NWA ended its five-year partnership with TNA, and TNA later introduced a new X Division belt.
Eric Young's win over Sheik Abdul Bashir was stripped by Jim Cornette because the referee helped him win.
A tournament at Genesis 2009 crowned Alex Shelley as the new champion after Young's reign was stripped.
Austin Aries announced he would vacate the title for a TNA World Heavyweight Championship match, leaving the title vacant.
Chris Sabin relinquished the title to invoke Option C, leaving it vacant until a tournament.
Austin Aries relinquished the title to invoke Option C, leaving it vacant until a tournament.
Rockstar Spud relinquished the title to invoke Option C, leaving it vacant until a tournament.
The belt was overhauled to reflect TNA's short-lived change to the Global Force Wrestling name.
Josh Alexander invoked Option C, vacating the title; a tournament later crowned Trey Miguel.
Frankie Kazarian vacated the title to invoke Option C, and an eight-man tournament was announced.
Leon Slater relinquished the title to invoke Option C for a TNA World Championship match, leaving it vacant.
